techParks.name: Bengaluru Aerospace Park
techParks.description: KIADB's Hi-Tech, Defence and Aerospace Park (Phase 1, with an Aerospace SEZ) along SH104 north-east of Kempegowda International Airport; the ~1,000-acre industrial park holds Boeing's 43-acre BIETC campus, Collins' 26-acre operations centre, Dynamatic's Aerotropolis, Eaton Aerospace, TASL and Centum.

techParks.name: Boeing India Engineering and Technology Center
techParks.description: Boeing's 43-acre, Rs 1,600 crore engineering campus inside the Aerospace Park, inaugurated January 2024 with Building 2 added in August 2024; Boeing's largest facility of its kind outside the US.

techParks.name: North Gate Business Park
techParks.description: Multi-phase office park on Bellary Road at Kogilu Cross, Yelahanka; Collins Aerospace's 413,000 sq ft Global Engineering & Technology Center (2022), its Engineering Development and Test Centre (2025) and Pratt & Whitney's India Engineering Center (2023) are here. Phase 3 was under construction in OSM.

techParks.name: John F. Welch Technology Centre
techParks.description: GE's first and largest integrated R&D campus outside the US, opened 17 September 2000 and named after Jack Welch; 4,000-5,000 engineers across GE Aerospace, GE Vernova and GE HealthCare on a walled campus at 2 Whitefield Road in the EPIP Zone.

techParks.name: EPIP Zone Whitefield
techParks.description: KIADB's Export Promotion Industrial Park at Whitefield, laid out in the 1990s and now a mix of engineering campuses (GE's JFWTC, Collins' Hoodi plant, Wabtec) and leased office parks (Embassy Crest, Whitefield Palms, Kalyani Platina); the point is a Nominatim-resolved EPIP address, not a zone centroid.

techParks.name: Kalyani Tech Park
techParks.description: Kalyani Developers' office park at Kundalahalli, Brookefield; Safran Electronics & Defense's 3,000 m2 R&D centre (operational August 2025, growing to 250 engineers) is here.

techParks.name: Kalyani Platina
techParks.description: Kalyani Developers' office park in EPIP Zone Phase 2, Whitefield, where Delphi (now Aptiv) set up its Bengaluru technical centre at No. 24; the point is the Aptiv/Delphi OSM POI, the park itself is not a polygon in OSM.

techParks.name: Embassy Crest
techParks.description: Embassy Group's built-to-suit campus on Whitefield Road in EPIP Zone Phase 1 that houses the main Mercedes-Benz Research and Development India site.

techParks.name: Whitefield Palms
techParks.description: Office building at Plot 9 & 10 (Plot 5-P), EPIP Zone Phase 1, Whitefield Road, home to the Daimler Truck Innovation Center India since 2021.

techParks.name: Brigade Tech Gardens
techParks.description: Brigade Group's ~3 million sq ft 'garden' office campus at Brookefield; MBRDI and Aptiv have second Bengaluru sites here per OSM.

techParks.name: Manyata Tech Park
techParks.description: Embassy's ~14 million sq ft Manyata Embassy Business Park at Nagavara; Rolls-Royce's aerospace engineering centre is on floors 9-10 of Block L3 (Hazel) and its 700-seat Global Capability Centre opened in the park in September 2025.

techParks.name: Bagmane Tech Park
aliases: Bagmane Tech Park CV Raman Nagar
techParks.description: Bagmane's 42-acre, 4.7 million sq ft campus at Byrasandra, CV Raman Nagar; Volvo Group India's head office is in Tridib, Boeing in Lakeview, and Alstom's India contact office is in the adjoining Embassy Prime building.

techParks.name: Bagmane World Technology Center
techParks.description: Bagmane's World Technology Center SEZ on the Outer Ring Road at Mahadevapura; Boeing occupies the Amber building (213,146 sq ft), the pre-2024 BIETC premises.

techParks.name: Bagmane Constellation Business Park
techParks.description: Bagmane's Constellation Business Park on the Outer Ring Road at Doddanekundi; Boeing shares the Orion building with Nvidia per the developer's page.

techParks.name: Bagmane Solarium City
techParks.description: Bagmane's 82-acre, 10.5 million sq ft campus at Kundalahalli on ITPL Main Road; Schneider Electric leased ~0.48 million sq ft here in 2023 for an R&D centre, and the developer lists Visteon, Shell and BHGE (Baker Hughes) among occupiers.

techParks.name: International Tech Park Bangalore
techParks.description: The 1994 Singapore-India ITPL/ITPB campus at Whitefield; GM's Technical Center India has been reported here since 2003 and OSM maps a Harman office inside, though neither was confirmed from a company page in this run.

techParks.name: Electronics City Phase 1
techParks.description: The original KEONICS/ELCIA electronics estate west of Hosur Road; in this lens it holds Siemens Technology and Services' campus, Yokogawa India's head office (Plot 96), Timken India's registered office, Bosch Global Software Technologies' 360 Degree Business Park centre and APC/Schneider.

techParks.name: Electronics City Phase 2
techParks.locality: Electronic City (east of Hosur Road, Veerasandra / Shantipura)
techParks.description: The KIADB eastern extension of Electronic City; Continental's Technical Center India, Moog Controls India and the Siemens Healthineers development centre are mapped here.

techParks.name: Bidadi Industrial Area
techParks.description: KIADB's industrial area at Bidadi south-west of the city; Toyota Kirloskar Motor's 850-acre two-plant site and its supplier cluster, plus a Bosch Limited plant.

techParks.name: Bommasandra Industrial Area
techParks.description: KIADB industrial estate on Hosur Road south of Electronic City; SKF's Bengaluru plant and the Mahindra Last Mile Mobility (ex-Mahindra Electric) plant are here.

techParks.name: Jigani Industrial Area
techParks.description: KIADB industrial estate at Jigani; Otis India's elevator factory (No. 92, Phase II) and TASL's composite-structures facility opened November 2025 are here.

techParks.name: Peenya Industrial Area
techParks.description: One of Asia's largest industrial estates, north-west Bengaluru; ABB India's registered office 'Disha' and works, Dynamatic's manufacturing and hydraulics plants, with Kennametal's HQ just beyond on Tumkur Road.

techParks.name: Hoskote Industrial Area
techParks.description: KIADB industrial area at Hoskote; Volvo Group's Indian truck, bus and construction-equipment plant.

techParks.name: RMZ Ecospace
techParks.description: RMZ's Ecospace campus on the Bellandur stretch of the Outer Ring Road; Bosch Global Software Technologies occupied Campus 1B per OSM.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Park
techParks.description: Prestige Group's office park at Kadubeesanahalli on the Outer Ring Road; Harman International (India) has an office here per OSM.

techParks.name: World Trade Center Bengaluru (Brigade Gateway)
techParks.description: Brigade's mixed-use Gateway campus with the WTC tower on Dr Rajkumar Road; Toyota Tsusho India's office is on the campus per OSM.

techParks.name: Shell Technology Centre Bangalore
techParks.description: Shell's 52-acre technology centre in the KIADB Hardware Park near the airport, one of its three global R&D hubs; the OSM campus polygon sits inside the Hardware Park.

techParks.name: KIADB Hardware Park
techParks.description: KIADB's Hardware Park beside the airport road, which contains the Shell Technology Centre Bangalore campus.

techParks.name: RMZ Latitude Commercial
techParks.description: RMZ's Latitude / Azure office block on Bellary Road at Hebbal; an OSM POI places a Boeing office here (unconfirmed).

techParks.name: Brigade Magnum
techParks.description: Brigade's office building on Bellary Road at Kodigehalli Gate; OSM places an ABB office here (unconfirmed). Point is the ABB POI, not a polygon centroid.

techParks.name: Bhoruka Tech Park
techParks.description: Office park on Whitefield Road, Mahadevapura, on the former Bhoruka industrial land; OSM maps ABB's Block-1 and a Hitachi Energy office here, the ex-ABB power-grids technology campus.

techParks.name: Embassy TechVillage
techParks.description: Embassy's ~9 million sq ft campus on the Outer Ring Road; Rockwell Collins was on its 2020 occupier list and has since consolidated into Yelahanka.

techParks.name: Brigade Metropolis
techParks.description: Brigade's mixed-use Metropolis campus on Whitefield Road; OSM places a Volvo office in the Summit 2 building (unconfirmed). Point is the Volvo POI.

techParks.name: Bosch Adugodi Campus
techParks.description: Bosch Limited's 76-acre historic MICO works on Hosur Road at Adugodi, being redeveloped as the Spark.NXT smart campus; it is Bosch's India headquarters and registered office.

techParks.name: Rajajinagar IT Park
techParks.locality: Rajajinagar Industrial Estate (Dr Rajkumar Road side)
techParks.description: KSSIDC's IT/BT park inside the Rajajinagar Industrial Estate; ABB India's R&D and office block at Plots 1-4 is here per an ABB job listing and OSM. Point is the ABB POI, not a park polygon.

techParks.name: RMZ Titanium
techParks.description: RMZ's Titanium office building on Old Airport Road, Domlur; OSM places GKN Aerospace's engineering office beside it (unconfirmed).

companies.name: Boeing
companies.description: US aerospace major; Bengaluru hosts the Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC), its largest engineering campus outside the US, plus leased Bagmane offices it grew out of.

offices.label: BIETC campus - Devanahalli (Building 1 and 2)
offices.locality: Devanahalli (KIADB Hi-Tech Defence and Aerospace Park, Bhatramarenahalli)
offices.address: KIADB Hi-Tech Defence and Aerospace Park, Devanahalli, Bengaluru Rural 562149
offices.evidence: PM Modi inaugurated the 43-acre, Rs 1,600 crore BIETC campus in the Hightech Defence and Aerospace Park, Devanahalli, in January 2024 and Boeing opened Building 2 there in August 2024 (https://www.thenewsminute.com/karnataka/pm-modi-inaugurates-bietc-in-bengaluru, https://www.boeing.co.in/news/2024/bietc-b2-inauguration); OSM maps the campus polygon 'Boeing India Engineering and Technology Center' (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/991727364).

offices.label: Bagmane World Technology Center - Amber
offices.address: Bagmane World Technology Center, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru 560048
offices.evidence: Bagmane's WTC page assigns Boeing to the Amber building (https://www.bagmanegroup.com/portfolio/world-technology-centre) and OSM has an office POI 'Boeing' there (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/6853514009); this is the pre-2024 BIETC leased space, so occupancy after the Devanahalli consolidation is not re-verified.

offices.label: Bagmane Tech Park - Lakeview
offices.address: Bagmane Tech Park, Byrasandra, C.V. Raman Nagar, Bengaluru 560093
offices.evidence: Bagmane's Tech Park page lists Boeing as a Lakeview occupier (https://www.bagmanegroup.com/portfolio/bagmane-tech-park); 2023 press said most engineers 'will continue to work from the BIETC in Bengaluru's Bagmane Tech Park'.

offices.label: Bagmane Constellation Business Park - Orion
offices.address: Bagmane Constellation Business Park, Doddanekundi, Bengaluru 560048
offices.evidence: Bagmane's Constellation page shows Boeing as an occupier of the Orion building (https://www.bagmanegroup.com/portfolio/bagmane-constellation-business-park); tower-level pin from Nominatim, no second source.

offices.label: RMZ Latitude / Azure office - Hebbal
offices.address: RMZ Latitude Commercial, Bellary Road, Hebbal, Bengaluru 560024
offices.evidence: Only an OSM office POI 'Boeing' inside the RMZ Latitude Commercial polygon on Bellary Road places Boeing here (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/11205796366); no company or press source reached.

companies.name: Airbus
companies.description: European aircraft maker; Bengaluru holds its India engineering and digital centres (since 2007) and, from March 2026, the 880,000 sq ft Airbus India Technology Centre; the India HQ itself is at Delhi airport.

offices.label: Airbus India Technology Centre (AITC) - presumed Belathur/Kadugodi site
offices.address: Dinnur Main Road, Belathur, Whitefield, Bengaluru 560067
offices.evidence: Airbus inaugurated the ~880,000 sq ft, 5,000-seat Airbus India Technology Centre in Bengaluru on 6 March 2026 (https://themachinemaker.com/news/airbus-opens-major-technology-center-in-bengaluru-to-expand-engineering-and-aviation-support/, https://ssfglobal.in/?p=40098) but no article fetched names the locality; the pin is OSM's recently mapped office POI 'Airbus India Private Limited' at Belathur, which Nominatim confirms (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/13013588732), so the match of campus to POI is inferred.

offices.label: Airbus Group India engineering office - Mahadevapura (OSM)
offices.address: Whitefield Road, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru 560048
offices.evidence: OSM office POI 'Airbus Group India Pvt Ltd' on Whitefield Road, Mahadevapura (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/1536507290); Airbus says its India engineering centre dates from 2007 with 700+ then 1,500+ engineers (https://www.airbus.com/en/our-worldwide-presence/airbus-in-india/engineering-and-innovation) but names no building, and whether this site survives the 2026 consolidation is unverified.

companies.name: Safran
companies.description: French engine and avionics group; in Bengaluru it has an electronics R&D centre, the Safran HAL Aircraft Engines JV plant near the airport, an electronics plant under construction, and Safran Engineering Services offices.

offices.label: Safran Electronics & Defense R&D centre - Kalyani Tech Park
offices.address: Kalyani Tech Park, Kundalahalli, Brookefield, Bengaluru 560037
offices.evidence: Safran's 11 Feb 2025 release says the R&D centre 'spanning 3,000 square meters in Kalyani Tech Park' opens August 2025 and grows to 250 engineers (reported by https://evertiq.com/news/2025-02-13-safran-opens-new-electronics-site-and-an-rd-centre-in-india and https://themachinemaker.com/news/safran-expands-footprint-in-india-with-new-electronics-manufacturing-facility-and-rd-center-in-bengaluru/); pinned to OSM's Kalyani Tech Park polygon (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/414833843).

offices.label: Safran HAL Aircraft Engines JV plant - Aerospace SEZ
offices.locality: Devanahalli (KIADB Aerospace SEZ near the airport)
offices.address: KIADB Aerospace SEZ, Devanahalli
offices.evidence: The 50/50 Safran Aircraft Engines-HAL JV plant for LEAP engine piping was inaugurated on 8 July 2022 'in a Special Economic Zone near the Bangalore airport' (https://www.etvbharat.com/english/bharat/ceo-of-french-company-safran-group-calls-on-def-min-rajnath-singh/na20220706070758184184722, https://www.aviation-defence-universe.com/ceo-of-french-aircraft-engine-maker-safran-group-calls-on-raksha-mantri-shri-rajnath-singh-in-new-delhi); no plot number, so the pin is the Bengaluru Aerospace Park centroid.

offices.label: Safran Electronics & Defense production site - airport area (under construction)
offices.address: Airport area, Devanahalli
offices.evidence: The same Safran release announces a 12,000 m2 electronics production site 'in the airport area of Bengaluru' employing ~400 with operations from H1 2026 (https://evertiq.com/news/2025-02-13-safran-opens-new-electronics-site-and-an-rd-centre-in-india); exact plot not published, pin is the Aerospace Park centroid.

offices.label: Safran Engineering Services India - Bannerghatta Road
offices.address: Bannerghatta Road, Bengaluru 560076
offices.evidence: OSM office POI 'Safran Engineering Services India' carrying the company website safran-engineering.com, beside the Kalyani Magnum park on Bannerghatta Road (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/5100578921); not confirmed from a Safran page in this run.

offices.label: Safran Engineering Services - Iblur / Ambalipura
offices.address: Ambalipura, Iblur, Bengaluru 560102
offices.evidence: OSM office POI 'Safran Engineering Services' at Ambalipura, Iblur, confirmed by Nominatim reverse lookup (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/7989324487); OSM only.

companies.name: Collins Aerospace
companies.description: RTX's aerospace-systems unit; Bengaluru holds its 413,000 sq ft Global Engineering & Technology Center and test centre at Yelahanka, a legacy Goodrich plant at Hoodi/EPIP and a 26-acre manufacturing site in the KIADB Aerospace Park.

offices.label: Global Engineering & Technology Center and EDTC - North Gate Business Park
offices.address: North Gate Business Park, Kogilu Cross, Bellary Road, Yelahanka, Bengaluru 560064
offices.evidence: Collins opened the 413,000 sq ft GETC at Northgate Tech Park in December 2022 to absorb ~3,000 engineers from three other Bengaluru sites (https://www.pax-intl.com/ife-connectivity/tech-hardware/2022/12/15/collins-aerospace-opens-new-facilities-in-india/) and its Engineering Development and Test Centre at the North Gate campus, Yelahanka, in March 2025 (https://www.theweek.in/wire-updates/national/2025/03/05/mes23-ka-aerospace-sector.html); OSM maps 'Collins Aerospace' and 'Collins Aerospace EDTC' there (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/11572254990).

offices.label: Collins India Operations Center - KIADB Aerospace Park
offices.address: KIADB Aerospace Park, Devanahalli, Bengaluru Rural 562149
offices.evidence: Press on the December 2022 opening describes the 26-acre Collins India Operations Center in the Hitech Defense and Aerospace Park making seats, lighting, sensors and evacuation slides with 2,200 staff by 2026 (https://industrialautomationindia.in/newsitm/14868/Collins-Aerospace-opens-new-engineering-and-global-operations-centers-in-India/news); OSM maps the 'Collins Aerospace' building polygon beside Boeing's campus (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/991727363).

offices.label: Bengaluru Operations Plant (Hoodi Site 1, ex-Goodrich) - EPIP
offices.address: EPIP Industrial Area, Hoodi, Whitefield, Bengaluru 560066
offices.evidence: Collins' own announcements name the 'Bengaluru Operations Plant (Hoodi Site 1)' as one of its two Bengaluru manufacturing sites (https://www.spsairbuz.com/news/?id=229); OSM maps 'Collins Aerospace' on the EPIP Industrial Area, Divyasree Technopark Road (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/9846046251).

offices.label: Embassy TechVillage office (consolidated into GETC)
offices.address: Embassy TechVillage, Outer Ring Road, Bellandur, Bengaluru 560103
offices.evidence: Embassy TechVillage's occupier list (data as of 30 Sep 2020) named Rockwell Collins; Collins said in 2022 that engineers from three other Bengaluru locations would move into the Yelahanka GETC (https://www.pax-intl.com/ife-connectivity/tech-hardware/2022/12/15/collins-aerospace-opens-new-facilities-in-india/), so this site is recorded as closed.

companies.name: GE Aerospace
companies.description: Jet-engine maker; its Bengaluru engineers sit in the John F. Welch Technology Centre at Whitefield, GE's first and largest multidisciplinary R&D campus outside the US (shared with GE Vernova and GE HealthCare).

offices.label: John F. Welch Technology Centre - Whitefield
offices.address: 2 Whitefield Road, EPIP Zone, Whitefield, Bengaluru 560066
offices.evidence: GE Aerospace job listings give the office as '2 Whitefield Road, Bengaluru 560066' and Wikipedia describes JFWTC as GE's Whitefield research campus founded 17 Sep 2000 with 4,000-5,000 engineers (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_F._Welch_Technology_Centre); OSM maps the campus with operator General Electric (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/180969776).

companies.name: Rolls-Royce
companies.description: UK engine maker; its Bengaluru aerospace engineering centre and 700-seat global capability centre are in Manyata, and the HAL joint venture IAMPL machines engine parts near the HAL airport.

offices.label: Engineering Centre (Aerospace) - Manyata Block L3 Hazel
offices.address: 9th & 10th Floor, Block L3 (Hazel), Manyata Embassy Business Park, Nagawara, Bengaluru 560045
offices.evidence: Rolls-Royce India's contacts page: 'Rolls-Royce India Private Limited, 9th and 10th Floor, Block L3 (Hazel), Manyata Embassy Business Park, Hebbal Outer Ring Road, Nagawara, Bengaluru 560045' (https://www.rolls-royce.com/country-sites/india/contacts.aspx).

offices.label: Global Capability and Innovation Centre - Manyata (block not named)
offices.address: Manyata Embassy Business Park, Nagawara, Bengaluru 560045
offices.evidence: Rolls-Royce opened a 700-seat Global Capability Centre at Manyata Embassy Business Park on 17 Sep 2025 (https://www.storyboard18.com/brand-marketing/rolls-royce-opens-its-largest-global-capability-centre-in-bengaluru-81115.htm, https://machinist.in/2025/09/rolls-royce-inaugurates-700-seat-global-capability-centre-in-bengaluru/); block not named, so the pin is the park centroid.

offices.label: International Aerospace Manufacturing (HAL-Rolls-Royce JV) - Kempapura
offices.address: Survey No. 3, Kempapura, Bellandur Post, Bengaluru 560037
offices.evidence: OSM maps 'International Aerospace Manufacturing pvt.ltd, Survey No-3 Kempapura, Bellandur' (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/4447064801); IAMPL is the 50:50 HAL-Rolls-Royce JV making engine rings and compressor parts (https://www.rolls-royce.com/country-sites/india/partners-in-progress/engineering.aspx).

companies.name: Pratt & Whitney
companies.description: RTX engine maker; its $36m India Engineering Center and India Capability Center share the North Gate campus at Yelahanka with Collins Aerospace.

offices.label: India Engineering Center and India Capability Center - North Gate Business Park
offices.address: North Gate Business Park, Kogilu Cross, Bellary Road, Yelahanka, Bengaluru 560064
offices.evidence: Pratt & Whitney opened the $36m India Engineering Centre in January 2023 'co-located in Yelahanka with the Pratt & Whitney India Capability Centre' and the Collins GETC, planning 500 staff (https://www.outlookbusiness.com/news/pratt-whitney-opens-36-million-engineering-centre-in-bengaluru-news-255031); OSM maps 'Pratt & Whitney India' inside North Gate Business Park (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/11566442300).

companies.name: Honeywell
companies.description: US aerospace, automation and building-technology conglomerate; Honeywell Technology Solutions Lab runs two Outer Ring Road campuses at Bellandur plus a Bannerghatta Road site.

offices.label: Campus 1 - Adarsh Prime Project, Devarabisanahalli
offices.address: No. 19/2, Adarsh Prime Project, Devarabisanahalli Village, Varthur Hobli, Bengaluru 560103
offices.evidence: Honeywell's India locations page lists 'Bangalore - Campus 1, Honeywell Technology Solutions Lab Pvt. Ltd., No. 19/2, Adarsh Prime Project, Devarabisanahalli Village, Varthur Hobli, Bengaluru 560103' (https://www.honeywell.com/in/en/careers/locations/india); the pin is Photon's Outer Ring Road point for Devarabisanahalli, not the building.

offices.label: Campus 2 - Boganahalli / Doddakannahalli
offices.locality: Doddakannahalli (Outer Ring Road, beside RMZ Ecoworld)
offices.address: Survey No. 96 & 97, Boganahalli Village and 72/2 & 72/5, Doddakannahalli Village, Varthur Hobli, Bengaluru 560103
offices.evidence: The same Honeywell page lists 'Bangalore - Campus 2 ... Survey No. 96 & 97, Boganahalli Village, Survey No. 72/2 & 72/5, Doddakannahalli Village, Varthur Hobli, Bengaluru 560103' (https://www.honeywell.com/in/en/careers/locations/india); OSM maps 'Honeywell Technology Solutions' on RMZ Eco World Road (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/11553915354).

offices.label: Bannerghatta Road campus - 151/1 Doraisanipalya
offices.address: No. 151/1, Doraisanipalya, Bannerghatta Road, Bengaluru 560076
offices.evidence: A Naukri company listing gives Honeywell Technology Solutions at 'No. 151/1, Doraisanipalya, Bannerghatta Road, Bangalore 560076' (https://companies.naukri.com/honeywell-jobs/contact) and OSM maps a commercial site 'Honeywell Technology Solutions Lab Pvt Ltd' there (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/121004026); it is not on Honeywell's current locations page, so it may be legacy.

companies.name: Thales
companies.description: French defence-electronics group; its Bengaluru Engineering Competence Centre (2019, 500+ engineers) gained a second building in November 2023, but no fetched source names the park.

offices.label: Bengaluru office (OSM 'Thales', Richmond Road) - ECC building not located
offices.address: Richmond Road, Bengaluru 560025
offices.evidence: Thales launched a second Bengaluru building in November 2023 as an extension of its 2019 Engineering Competence Centre, now over 500 staff (https://www.thalesgroup.com/en/news-centre/press-releases/thales-expands-footprint-india-second-office-bengaluru, https://www.hrkatha.com/news/thales-inaugurates-office-in-bengaluru/), without naming the location; the only mapped Thales point is an OSM brand POI on Richmond Road (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/11542415992), so the ECC's park remains unconfirmed.

companies.name: Dassault Systemes
companies.description: French 3D-design and PLM software house (CATIA, 3DEXPERIENCE); its Bengaluru offices are in Jayanagar. Dassault Aviation, the aircraft maker, has no Bengaluru office found.

offices.label: Bangalore Nanda office - Jayanagar 3rd Block
offices.address: No. 45, 22nd Cross, 5th Main Road, 3rd Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru 560011
offices.evidence: Dassault Systemes' office page gives 'Nanda, No 45 22nd Cross, 5th Main Road 3rd Block, Jayanagar, Bangalore 560011' (https://www.3ds.com/about/company/office-locations/india/bangalore-nanda); OSM maps 'Dassault Systemes' with the same house number and website (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/6433396485).

offices.label: Bangalore Pramuk office - Jayanagar
offices.address: Jayanagar, Bengaluru 560070
offices.evidence: Dassault Systemes' India office list also carries a 'Bangalore Pramuk' office in Jayanagar 560070 (https://www.3ds.com/fr/about/company/office-locations/india/3ds-bangalore-pramuk); OSM has a second 'Dassault Systems' POI in Jayanagar (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/12308893237) taken as that office.

companies.name: Eaton
companies.description: Irish-domiciled power-management group; Eaton Aerospace India runs a works in the KIADB Aerospace Park at Devanahalli (its India Innovation Center is in Pune).

offices.label: Eaton Aerospace India - KIADB Aerospace Park
offices.address: SH104, KIADB Aerospace Park, Bhatramarenahalli, Devanahalli 562149
offices.evidence: OSM maps an industrial works polygon 'Eaton Aerospace India' on SH104 inside the Bengaluru Aerospace Park, which Nominatim reverse lookup confirms (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/1240497180); eaton.com's India page returned 404 in this run, so this is OSM-only.

companies.name: Dynamatic Technologies
companies.description: Bengaluru-headquartered aerostructures and hydraulics maker (Boeing, Airbus and Bell supplier); registered office at its Aerotropolis in the KIADB Aerospace Park with plants in Peenya.

offices.label: Dynamatic Aerotropolis - registered office, Dynamatic-Oldland Aerospace and Dynauton
offices.address: 55, KIADB Aerospace Park, Devanahalli, Bengaluru 562149
offices.evidence: Dynamatic's contact page gives the Registered Office as 'JKM Plaza, Dynamatic Aerotropolis, 55, KIADB Aerospace Park, Bangalore 562149' with the aerospace and UAV divisions at the same site (http://www.dynamatics.com/contact-us/); OSM maps the 'Dynamatic' site in the park (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/801307395).

offices.label: Dynamatic Manufacturing - Peenya II Stage (Plot V-77 & 78)
offices.address: Plot No. V-77 & 78, Peenya Industrial Estate, Peenya II Stage, Bengaluru 560058

coverageNotes: SEARCH BUDGET: the shared WebSearch quota ran out after 16 queries and WebFetch safety checks were rate-limited for most corporate domains late in the run, so many company location pages (bosch.in, siemens, abb, continental, zf, aptiv, harman, eaton, hitachienergy, yokogawa, timken, skf, tatatechnologies, textron, wabtec, trane, otis, collins, boeing.co.in) returned 404/403/503 or were blocked; where that happened the pin is an OpenStreetMap POI/polygon, a Nominatim/Photon hit, or a developer tenant page, and confidence is marked low or medium accordingly. CONFIRMED FROM PRIMARY OR TWO SECONDARY SOURCES: Boeing BIETC Devanahalli, Collins GETC Yelahanka and Aerospace Park, Pratt & Whitney Yelahanka, Rolls-Royce Manyata L3 Hazel, GE JFWTC, Honeywell's two ORR campuses, Dassault Systemes Jayanagar Nanda, Dynamatic's three sites, Daimler Truck Innovation Center (Whitefield Palms), BGSW Koramangala and 360 Business Park, Bosch Adugodi, Volvo Tridib, Schneider at Bagmane Solarium, Kennametal Tumkur Road, Otis Jigani, ABB Nelamangala and Rajajinagar, Toyota Kirloskar Bidadi, Alstom Embassy Prime, Safran's Kalyani Tech Park R&D centre. NOT LOCATED PRECISELY: Airbus India Technology Centre (6 March 2026, 880,000 sq ft, 5,000 seats) - every fetched article names only Bengaluru, so it is pinned to OSM's new 'Airbus India Private Limited' POI at Belathur/Kadugodi as a presumption; the Airbus India HQ opened October 2024 is at Delhi airport, not Bengaluru. Thales' Engineering Competence Centre (500+ staff, second building Nov 2023) - no source names the park, pinned to an OSM brand POI on Richmond Road. Rolls-Royce's Sept 2025 GCC block within Manyata. Safran HAL Aircraft Engines' plot in the Aerospace SEZ and Safran's airport-area electronics plant (planned). LEFT OUT FOR LACK OF ANY BENGALURU EVIDENCE: Lockheed Martin (no Bengaluru office found; Tata Lockheed Martin Aerostructures is Hyderabad), Dassault Aviation (Nagpur JV only), Leonardo (Adani JV, no Bengaluru site), ZF (tech centres in Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Coimbatore), Magna, Cummins, John Deere (Pune), Emerson (Pune), Danfoss (Chennai), Carrier (Hyderabad), Johnson Controls, Hexagon (Hyderabad), Hitachi Rail STS (Bengaluru HQ claimed but no address reached), Siemens Mobility (folded into Siemens aliases), Trane Technologies (a Bengaluru engineering centre is reported but no address reached; Photon returned junk), Textron India (site gives no address), Tata Technologies (locations page rate-limited), Honda R&D (Greater Noida; only an HMSI south regional sales office exists in Rajajinagar per OSM), Toyota Connected (Chennai), L&T Defence (no Bengaluru design centre confirmed; L&T Technology Services is lens E05). OTHER NOTES: Safran Aircraft Engine Services' LEAP MRO and Safran Electrical & Power are in Hyderabad, not Bengaluru, despite the brief. Honeywell's Bannerghatta Road site appears on Naukri and OSM but not on Honeywell's current locations page. BGSW's RMZ Ecospace and Bosch's 690 Hosur Road sites are OSM-only and may be vacated. Collins' Embassy TechVillage office is recorded closed on the strength of the 2022 consolidation statement. Timken's registered address says Phase II but the OSM polygon lies west of Hosur Road, so Phase 1 is used. Boeing's Bagmane sites (WTC Amber, Tech Park Lakeview, Constellation Orion) are still listed by the developer but occupancy after the 2024 Devanahalli consolidation was not re-verified. Ingersoll Rand's Bannerghatta Road registered office could not be fetched; only an OSM POI near Infantry Road is pinned. Baker Hughes, Centum, QuEST and Cyient are left to the energy/engineering-services lenses. Geocode coordinates marked park-centroid or photon are not building-level.
